In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (a) the estimation of the demand for fluid milk and cheese in Canada; (b) the estimation of demand for fluid milk in the Maritimes and for cheese in Ontario; (c) the estimation of elasticities of demand; (d) the estimation of returns on investment in fluid milk and cheese promotion in Canada; and (e) the estimation of return on investment in fluid and cheese promotion in the Maritims and Ontario.
the economic evaluation of generic fluid milk and generic cheese marketing investment in Canada.
the economic evaluation of marketing investment in fluid milk and cheese in Canada.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the generic advertising and promotion programs for cheese and fluid milk are effective and efficient in generating net benefits to the dairy industry.
the return on investments in fluid milk advertising and promotion are positive and the returns on investments in cheese advertising and promotion are also positive.

the net return on investment in fluid milk advertising and promotion for Ontario and the Maritime provinces is positive, but that the return on investment for the promotion of cheese in Canada (excluding Quebec) is negative.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the return on investment in generic fluid marketing in Ontario and the Marities is positive, but not as strong as in the 2002-2006 period.
the return on investment for the period from 2007-11 for generic advertising for milk and cheese in Ontario is positive.
, for the most part, the investment in marketing for generic fluid milk and for cheese is still profitable for the 2006-2009 period in the Maritimes, Ontario and in the rest of Canada.
The main takeaway from our work is that
generic fluid milk and generic cheese investments are profitable.
the return on investment for fluid milk is lower than what was estimated by the previous studies.
the net returns from generic fluid milk and generic cheese marketing investment are positive.
